results.question: 2026年各经营单元收入排名前十
results.sql: SELECT u.unit_name AS 经营单元, SUM(r.revenue) AS 收入额 FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4) = '2026' GROUP BY u.unit_name ORDER BY 收入额 DESC LIMIT 10
results.ref_sql: SELECT u.unit_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS revenue_2026 FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY u.unit_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 2026年各产品线收入占比
results.sql: SELECT pl.line_name AS 产品线, SUM(r.revenue) AS 收入额, ROUND(SUM(r.revenue)*100.0/(SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2026'),1) AS 占比 FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id = r.product_line_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4) = '2026' GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 收入额 DESC
results.ref_sql: SELECT pl.line_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev, ROUND(SUM(r.revenue)*100.0/(SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2026'),1) AS pct FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id = r.product_line_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

results.question: 2026年各产品线收入同比变化
results.sql: SELECT pl.line_name AS 产品线, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS 收入2026, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS 收入2025, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END))*100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END),0),1) AS 同比增速 FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id = r.product_line_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4) IN ('2025','2026') GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 收入2026 DESC
results.ref_sql: SELECT pl.line_name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' THEN r.revenue END) AS rev_2026, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END) AS rev_2025, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' THEN r.revenue END)-SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END))*100.0/SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END),1) AS yoy_pct FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=r.product_line_id GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 4 DESC

results.question: 2026年政企行业收入在3000万到5000万之间的经营单元
results.sql: SELECT u.unit_name AS 经营单元, SUM(r.revenue) AS 收入额 FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id JOIN dim_industry i ON i.industry_id = r.industry_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4) = '2026' AND i.industry_category = '政企' GROUP BY u.unit_name HAVING SUM(r.revenue) BETWEEN 3000 AND 5000 ORDER BY 收入额 DESC
results.ref_sql: SELECT u.unit_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=r.unit_id JOIN dim_industry i ON i.industry_id=r.industry_id WHERE i.industry_category='政企' AND substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY u.unit_name HAVING SUM(r.revenue) BETWEEN 3000 AND 5000 ORDER BY 2 DESC

results.question: 北京代表处2026年各产品线的目标和完成率
results.sql: SELECT pl.line_name AS 产品线, t.commercial_target AS 商业目标, COALESCE(r.rev,0) AS 收入额, ROUND(COALESCE(r.rev,0)*100.0/t.commercial_target,1) AS 完成率 FROM fact_target t JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id = t.product_line_id JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id = t.unit_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT unit_id, product_line_id, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4) = '2026' GROUP BY unit_id, product_line_id) r ON r.unit_id = t.unit_id AND r.product_line_id = t.product_line_id WHERE t.year = 2026 AND u.unit_name = '北京代表处' ORDER BY 完成率 DESC
results.ref_sql: SELECT pl.line_name, t.commercial_target, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.revenue),0)*100.0/t.commercial_target,1) AS rate FROM fact_target t JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=t.unit_id JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=t.product_line_id LEFT JOIN fact_revenue r ON r.unit_id=t.unit_id AND r.product_line_id=t.product_line_id AND substr(r.month,1,4)=CAST(t.year AS TEXT) WHERE t.year=2026 AND u.unit_name='北京代表处' GROUP BY pl.line_name, t.commercial_target ORDER BY rate DESC

results.ref_sql: SELECT p.model_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product p ON p.model_id=r.model_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY p.model_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

results.ref_sql: SELECT i.industry_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_industry i ON i.industry_id=r.industry_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

results.question: 2026年9月各产品线收入环比8月
results.sql: SELECT pl.line_name AS 产品线, SUM(CASE WHEN r.month='2026-09' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS 九月收入, SUM(CASE WHEN r.month='2026-08' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS 八月收入, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN r.month='2026-09' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.month='2026-08' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END))*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.month='2026-08' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END),0),1) AS 环比增长率 FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id = r.product_line_id WHERE r.month IN ('2026-09','2026-08') GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 九月收入 DESC
results.ref_sql: SELECT pl.line_name, SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue END) AS m09, SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue END) AS m08, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue END)-SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue END))*100.0/SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue END),1) AS mom FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=r.product_line_id GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 4 DESC

results.question: 2025年和2026年的目标与收入合计分别是多少
results.sql: SELECT t.年份 AS 年份, t.商业目标合计 AS 商业目标, COALESCE(r.收入合计, 0) AS 收入额 FROM (SELECT year AS 年份, SUM(commercial_target) AS 商业目标合计 FROM fact_target WHERE year IN (2025, 2026) GROUP BY year) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS 年份, SUM(revenue) AS 收入合计 FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4) IN ('2025','2026') GROUP BY CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INTEGER)) r ON r.年份 = t.年份 ORDER BY 年份
results.ref_sql: SELECT a.year, a.target, COALESCE(b.rev,0) AS rev FROM (SELECT year, SUM(commercial_target) AS target FROM fact_target GROUP BY year) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS y, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue GROUP BY 1) b ON b.y=a.year ORDER BY a.year

results.ref_sql: SELECT pl.line_name, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' THEN r.revenue END)-SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END))*100.0/SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END),1) AS yoy FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=r.product_line_id GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 2026年收入前5的经营单元及其完成率和同比
results.sql: WITH tgt AS (SELECT unit_id, SUM(commercial_target) AS target FROM fact_target WHERE year = 2026 GROUP BY unit_id) SELECT u.unit_name AS 经营单元, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4) = '2026' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS 收入额, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4) = '2026' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.target, 0), 1) AS 完成率, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4) = '2026' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4) = '2025' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4) = '2025' THEN r.revenue ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS 同比 FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id LEFT JOIN tgt t ON t.unit_id = r.unit_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4) IN ('2025','2026') GROUP BY u.unit_id, u.unit_name, t.target ORDER BY 收入额 DESC LIMIT 5
results.ref_sql: WITH rev26 AS (SELECT unit_id, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY unit_id), rev25 AS (SELECT unit_id, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2025' GROUP BY unit_id), tgt AS (SELECT unit_id, SUM(commercial_target) AS target FROM fact_target WHERE year=2026 GROUP BY unit_id) SELECT u.unit_name, r26.rev AS rev_2026, ROUND(r26.rev*100.0/t.target,1) AS rate, ROUND((r26.rev-r25.rev)*100.0/r25.rev,1) AS yoy FROM rev26 r26 JOIN tgt t ON t.unit_id=r26.unit_id JOIN rev25 r25 ON r25.unit_id=r26.unit_id JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=r26.unit_id ORDER BY r26.rev DESC LIMIT 5
